deals.headline: Anthropic Partners with Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, and Goldman Sachs to Launch Enterprise AI Services Firm
deals.summary: Anthropic, Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman and Goldman Sachs formed a new AI-native enterprise services firm (later named Ode), backed by a consortium including General Atlantic, Leonard Green, Apollo, GIC and Sequoia; no amount was disclosed.
deals.evidence: Anthropic, Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, and Goldman Sachs today announced the formation of a new AI-native enterprise services firm that will work with companies to rapidly bring Claude into their core business operations. ... Alongside the founding partners, the new company is backed by a consortium of leading alternative asset managers including General Atlantic, Leonard Green, Apollo Global Management, GIC, and Sequoia Capital.

deals.investor: AI-native enterprise services firm backed by Anthropic, Blackstone and Hellman & Friedman (Ode)
deals.headline: The AI-Native Enterprise Services Firm Backed by Anthropic, Blackstone, and Hellman & Friedman Announces Acquisition of Fractional AI
deals.summary: The new AI services firm later named Ode acquired San Francisco applied AI services company Fractional AI as its founding operational core; terms were not disclosed.
deals.evidence: The recently announced AI-native enterprise services firm led by Anthropic, Blackstone, Hellman & Friedman, and others to help mid-size companies bring Claude into their core operations, today announced the acquisition of Fractional AI, a leading applied AI services company based in San Francisco.

deals.headline: Hyve to be acquired by Hellman & Friedman to accelerate next phase of growth
deals.summary: Hellman & Friedman agreed to acquire B2B events business Hyve Group from Providence Equity Partners and Searchlight Capital Partners; terms were not disclosed.
deals.evidence: Leading B2B events business Hyve Group (“Hyve”) today announces that private equity firm Hellman & Friedman (“H&F”) has agreed to acquire the company from Providence Equity Partners L.L.C. (“Providence”) and Searchlight Capital Partners (“Searchlight”), marking the next phase of Hyve’s growth and evolution.

deals.headline: Blackstone, Carlyle and Hellman & Friedman win PE Hub’s Overall Deal of the Year Award for Medline’s $7.2bn IPO
deals.summary: Medline, owned in equal shares by Blackstone, Carlyle and H&F, went public on Nasdaq in an IPO raising $7.2 billion including the greenshoe, valuing the company at $65 billion at its first-day close.
deals.evidence: They took the medical supplies maker public on December 17 in an initial public offering that netted $7.2 billion in proceeds (including a greenshoe option) and was 12x subscribed. The IPO valued the company at $65 billion, based on its closing price at the end of the first day of trading.

deals.headline: Blackstone, Carlyle and Hellman & Friedman win PE Hub’s Overall Deal of the Year Award for Medline’s $7.2bn IPO
deals.summary: Under Blackstone, Carlyle and H&F ownership, Medline carved out Ecolab’s global surgical products group in a $905 million deal in 2024.
deals.evidence: Under PE ownership, Medline closed eight add-ons, with the most pivotal being its 2024 carve-out of Ecolab’s global surgical products group in a $905 million deal.

deals.headline: Vantage Group Holdings to be acquired by Howard Hughes Holdings
deals.summary: Howard Hughes Holdings agreed to acquire 100% of Carlyle- and H&F-backed specialty insurer and reinsurer Vantage for $2.1 billion in cash, about 1.5x year-end 2025 book value.
deals.evidence: Vantage Group Holdings Ltd. (“Vantage”), a privately held leading specialty insurance and reinsurance company backed by Carlyle and Hellman & Friedman today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement for Howard Hughes Holdings Inc. (NYSE: HHH) (“Howard Hughes,” “HHH,” or the “Company”) to acquire 100% of Vantage for $2.1 billion in cash or approximately 1.5x year-end 2025 book value.

deals.headline: Blackstone Announces Agreement to Acquire Enverus

deals.evidence: Blackstone (NYSE: BX) announced today that private equity funds affiliated with Blackstone (“Blackstone”) have entered into a definitive agreement to acquire Enverus, a premier data analytics energy intelligence platform, from Hellman & Friedman and Genstar Capital.

deals.headline: Genesys Announces $1.5 Billion Investment by Salesforce and ServiceNow
deals.summary: Salesforce and ServiceNow committed $1.5 billion in equal amounts to Genesys, with proceeds used to repurchase shares from existing holders; H&F and Permira remain majority owners.
deals.evidence: Genesys®, a global cloud leader in AI-Powered Experience Orchestration, today announced $1.5 billion in new investment commitments from Salesforce and ServiceNow, with each company agreeing to invest an equal amount. ... Proceeds from the investment will be used to repurchase shares from the company’s existing equity holders. Hellman & Friedman and Permira remain the company’s majority equity owners.

deals.investor: T. Rowe Price Investment Management, Inc.
deals.headline: HUB Secures Significant Minority Investment and Reaches New Milestone With $29 Billion Valuation Demonstrating Confidence in the Company’s Sustainable Top Tier Organic Growth
deals.summary: H&F-backed HUB International agreed a minority common equity investment of about $1.6 billion led by T. Rowe Price-advised funds, Alpha Wave Global and Temasek, at a $29 billion total enterprise valuation.
deals.evidence: Hub International Limited (HUB), a leading global insurance brokerage and financial services firm, announced today that it has entered into a definitive agreement for a minority common equity investment of approximately $1.6 billion, valuing HUB at a $29 billion total enterprise valuation. The investment is being led by funds and accounts advised by T. Rowe Price Investment Management, Inc., Alpha Wave Global, and Temasek, with participation from other new and existing investors.

deals.seller: HgCapital, Bain Capital, ICG and management
deals.headline: Hellman & Friedman Acquires Controlling Interest In TeamSystem Holding SpA From HgCapital, Bain Capital, ICG and Management
deals.summary: H&F funds acquired a controlling interest in Italian software company TeamSystem from HgCapital, Bain Capital, ICG and management, with HgCapital retaining a minority stake; no price was stated.
deals.evidence: Private equity funds affiliated with Hellman & Friedman LLC (“H&F”) acquire a controlling interest in TeamSystem Holding SpA (“TeamSystem”), beginning a new chapter of growth for the Italian software company. Management will continue to invest in the business going forward and HgCapital intends to retain a minority stake.

deals.headline: Hellman & Friedman LLC to Become Majority Owner of Edelman Financial Services
deals.summary: Edelman Financial Services agreed to be acquired by H&F affiliates, with senior management and prior majority owner Lee Equity Partners retaining meaningful equity; terms were not disclosed.
deals.evidence: Edelman Financial Services, one of the largest independent financial planning firms in the nation, today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by affiliates of Hellman & Friedman LLC. H&F will own the business in partnership with Edelman’s senior management team and current majority owner Lee Equity Partners, both of whom will retain meaningful equity ownership in the firm. ... Terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

deals.headline: Hellman & Friedman Acquires Controlling Interest in Securitas Direct Verisure Group
deals.summary: H&F funds agreed to acquire Bain Capital's entire interest in Securitas Direct Verisure Group, becoming majority shareholder alongside management; no price was stated.
deals.evidence: Funds affiliated with Hellman & Friedman LLC (H&F), a leading US-based Private Equity firm, have agreed to acquire the entirety of Bain Capital’s interest in Securitas Direct Verisure Group. The acquisition places H&F in a majority shareholder position alongside Company management and creates an optimal platform for continued growth.

deals.seller: Asa HoldCo GmbH (funds advised by affiliates of Hellman & Friedman LLC and The Blackstone Group L.P.), Deutsche Telekom AG and other shareholders
deals.headline: Scout24 Sets IPO Price at EUR 30 per Share
deals.summary: Scout24 priced its Frankfurt IPO at EUR 30 per share, a total offer volume of about EUR 1,159 million including the greenshoe and a market capitalisation of EUR 3,228 million, with secondary shares sold by H&F- and Blackstone-owned Asa HoldCo and Deutsche Telekom.
deals.evidence: At the issue price of 30 EUR, Scout24 has a market capitalisation of EUR 3,228 million, and the total offer volume amounts to approximately EUR 1,159 million, assuming the full exercise of the greenshoe option.

deals.headline: TPG Capital and Leonard Green Partners Agree to Acquire Majority Stake in Ellucian
deals.summary: TPG Capital and Leonard Green agreed to acquire a majority interest in higher-education software provider Ellucian from Hellman & Friedman and co-investor JMI Equity; no price was stated.
deals.evidence: Ellucian, the leading global provider for higher education software and services, today announced that TPG Capital (“TPG”) and Leonard Green Partners (“Leonard Green”) have entered into a definitive agreement to acquire a majority interest in Ellucian from Hellman & Friedman (“H&F”) and co-investor JMI Equity.

deals.seller: Hellman & Friedman and other Wood Mackenzie shareholders
deals.headline: Verisk Analytics to Acquire Wood Mackenzie
deals.summary: Verisk Analytics agreed to acquire energy and metals research firm Wood Mackenzie from Hellman & Friedman and other shareholders for a purchase price of £1.850 billion (about $2.8 billion).
deals.evidence: Purchase price of £1.850 billion (approximately $2.8 billion) to be funded with about $2 billion in debt and up to $800 million in equity. Verisk Analytics, Inc. (Nasdaq:VRSK), a leading data analytics provider, today announced it has signed a definitive agreement to acquire Wood Mackenzie from Hellman & Friedman and other Wood Mackenzie shareholders.

deals.headline: Hellman & Friedman Successfully Sells its Remaining Holding in GTT’s Share Capital
deals.summary: An H&F affiliate sold its remaining GTT shareholding in a private placement to institutional investors, completing its exit from the stake acquired in 2008; proceeds were not stated.
deals.evidence: Gaztransport & Technigaz S.A. ... announces that H&F Luxembourg 1 S.à. r.l., an affiliate of Hellman & Friedman, has successfully completed the sale of its remaining holding in the share capital of GTT in a private placement to institutional investors.

deals.headline: Grocery Outlet Announces Partnership with Hellman & Friedman
deals.summary: Extreme-value grocer Grocery Outlet agreed to be acquired by H&F affiliates and its senior management from principal owner Berkshire Partners; terms were not disclosed.
deals.evidence: Grocery Outlet, Inc. ... today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to be acquired by affiliates of Hellman & Friedman LLC along with Grocery Outlet’s senior management team from its principal owner, Berkshire Partners LLC. The terms of the transaction were not disclosed.

deals.headline: ABRA Auto Body & Glass to Be Acquired by Hellman & Friedman and ABRA’s Senior Management Team
deals.summary: ABRA Auto Body & Glass agreed to be acquired from Palladium Equity Partners by H&F affiliates and its senior management; terms were not disclosed.
deals.evidence: ABRA Auto Body & Glass, (“ABRA”), a leading national damaged vehicle repair provider, and its principal owner, Palladium Equity Partners, LLC. (“Palladium”), is pleased to announce today a definitive agreement for ABRA to be acquired by affiliates of Hellman & Friedman, LLC. (“H&F”) along with ABRA’s senior management team.

deals.headline: Artisan Partners Asset Management Inc. Announces Secondary Offering of Common Stock
deals.summary: H&F affiliates agreed to sell their entire remaining Artisan Partners stake, 1,836,898 Class A shares or about 2.6% of equity, in an underwritten offering by Citigroup.
deals.evidence: Artisan Partners Asset Management Inc. (NYSE: APAM) ... is announcing today that affiliates of Hellman & Friedman LLC have agreed to sell 1,836,898 shares of the Company’s Class A common stock (representing their entire remaining stake in the Company and approximately 2.6% of the Company’s equity) in an underwritten public offering.

deals.headline: Internet Brands to Be Acquired by KKR
deals.summary: KKR agreed to acquire Internet Brands from Hellman & Friedman and JMI Equity, with CEO Bob Brisco and management holding a minority stake; no price was stated.
deals.evidence: Internet Brands ... announced it has signed a definitive agreement under which KKR, a leading global investment firm, will acquire Internet Brands from Hellman & Friedman and JMI Equity.

deals.seller: Hellman & Friedman and other Sheridan equity holders
deals.headline: AMSURG Corp. to Acquire Sheridan Healthcare in Transformational Transaction Valued at $2.35 Billion
deals.summary: AMSURG agreed to acquire H&F portfolio company Sheridan Healthcare in a cash and stock transaction valued at about $2.35 billion, including about $615 million of AMSURG equity issued to Sheridan's equity holders.
deals.evidence: AMSURG Corp. (NASDAQ:AMSG) and Sheridan Healthcare, a portfolio company of Hellman & Friedman, LLC, today announced that their respective Boards of Directors have unanimously approved a definitive agreement under which AMSURG will acquire Sheridan Healthcare in a cash and stock transaction valued at approximately $2.35 billion.

deals.headline: Hellman & Friedman Completes $1.1 Billion Acquisition of Renaissance Learning
deals.summary: H&F completed its acquisition of K-12 assessment company Renaissance Learning from the Permira funds, with Google Capital and management co-investing, in a deal valuing the company at about $1.1 billion.
deals.evidence: Renaissance Learning ... announced today that Hellman & Friedman ... has successfully completed its acquisition of Renaissance from the Permira funds. Google Capital and Renaissance’s management team co-invested in the transaction, which values the company at approximately $1.1 billion.

deals.headline: Berkshire Partners Enters Agreement To Acquire Catalina
deals.summary: Berkshire Partners agreed to acquire majority control of Catalina from Hellman & Friedman, which remains a significant investor; no price was stated.
deals.evidence: Catalina ... announced today that Boston-based investment firm Berkshire Partners LLC has entered into a definitive agreement to acquire majority control of the company from Hellman & Friedman LLC. Hellman & Friedman remains a significant investor.

deals.seller: Total Gas & Power Actifs Industriels and H&F Luxembourg 1, 2 and 3 S.à r.l.
deals.headline: Successful GTT Initial Public Offering
deals.summary: GTT's Euronext Paris IPO at €46 per share sold 13.5 million existing shares held by Total and H&F for about €621 million (€714 million with the over-allotment), valuing GTT at about €1.7 billion.
deals.evidence: Offering Price: € 46 per share, representing a market capitalization for GTT of approximately € 1.7 billion. Total size of the Offering: 13,500,000 existing shares sold by Total Gas & Power Actifs Industriels (Total), H&F Luxembourg 1 S.à.r.l., H&F Luxembourg 2 S.à.r.l. and H&F Luxembourg 3 S.à.r.l. (together H&F) representing approximately € 621 million, increased to € 714 million assuming the full exercise of the over-allotment option.

deals.headline: Kronos Lays Foundation for Next Phase of Growth; Adds World-Class Investors at $4.5 Billion Enterprise Valuation
deals.summary: Kronos agreed a recapitalization through a $750 million equity investment by Blackstone and GIC funds at a $4.5 billion enterprise valuation, with Hellman & Friedman remaining majority investor alongside JMI Equity.
deals.evidence: Kronos Incorporated today announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to effect a recapitalization of the company through a $750 million equity investment by funds managed by Blackstone (NYSE:BX) and GIC. Blackstone and GIC will invest in Kronos alongside the original investors Hellman & Friedman and JMI Equity. Hellman & Friedman will remain the majority investor in the company.

deals.seller: Hellman & Friedman LLC, Stone Point Capital LLC and other investors
deals.headline: KKR to Invest in Sedgwick
deals.summary: KKR and management agreed to acquire majority ownership of Sedgwick for about $2.4 billion from its investor group including Hellman & Friedman and Stone Point Capital.
deals.evidence: Sedgwick Claims Management Services, Inc. ... announced today that KKR, together with management, have signed an agreement to acquire majority ownership of Sedgwick for approximately $2.4 billion from its current group of investors, which includes Hellman & Friedman LLC and Stone Point Capital LLC.
